Youth protest unemployment, clash with police near Punjab CM's residence

Unemployed youths protesting in Punjab clashed with police on Tuesday as they attempted to march towards the residence of Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. The protesters were demonstrating against unemployment. Police used force to prevent the march, leading to the confrontation. The specific number of protesters and any injuries were not detailed in the coverage.
